c74object.name: el.npan~
c74object.description:
el.npan~ is a multi-channel circular equal-power panner that distributes a monophonic audio input across an arbitrary ring of speaker outputs (from 2 to 1024 channels). Pan location is controlled at audio rate by a signal in the right inlet ranging from 0.0 to 1.0. As the pan value moves from 0.0 to 1.0, the signal pans smoothly across each adjacent pair of outputs and wraps seamlessly from the final output channel back to the first output channel.
Inlets
Inlet 1 [Left Inlet] (signal): Monophonic audio input signal to be panned.
Inlet 2 [Right Inlet] (signal): Pan controller signal (0.0 to 1.0). Controls the continuous panning position around the speaker ring.
Outlets
Outlets 1 to N (signal): Audio signal outputs (2 to 1024 channels, determined by the object argument, default: 2).

inlet.description: Monophonic audio signal to be panned across the output channels.
Normalized audio-rate panning position ranging from 0.0 to 1.0. Values wrap circularly from the last speaker back to the first speaker.

outlet.description: Subsequent speaker channel audio outputs (up to 1024 channels).

objarg.name: output-count
objarg.description: The number of output channels to create (default: 2, range: 2 to 1024).

method.name: signal
method.digest: Audio input or pan control signal
method.description: Signal arriving at inlet 1 is the audio to be panned. Signal arriving at inlet 2 controls the normalized panning position (0.0 to 1.0) at audio rate.
